title: Employ staff under the Graphic Arts, Printing and Publishing Award 2020
what: Pay and employ staff at no less than the terms of the Graphic Arts, Printing and Publishing Award 2020.

laws.title: Graphic Arts, Printing and Publishing Award 2020

sources.title: Graphic Arts, Printing and Publishing Award 2020
sources.quote: 4.1 This industry and occupational award covers employers throughout Australia in the graphic arts, printing, publishing and associated industries and occupations and their employees in the classifications listed in clause 17 — Minimum rates and classification structure and Schedule A —Classification Definitions to the exclusion of any other modern award.

reach.note: National system employers that are companies, in every state.

sources.title: Graphic Arts, Printing and Publishing Award 2020
sources.quote: 4.2 Graphic arts, printing, publishing and associated industries and occupations means the following industries, parts of industries and occupations: (a) composing, reading, electrotyping, stereotyping, letterpress machining, lithographic machining, lithographing, screen printing, printing of all classes, slug-casting or type-casting machine attending and adjusting and/or repairing; (b) type-founding; (c) engraving, process engraving and/or photo engraving; (d) commercial and/or lithographic designing, writing and/or drawing; (e) publishing; (f) despatching which is incidental to the industries or parts of industries covered by the award; (g) book-binding, binding, paper ruling and/or paper cutting; (h) paper making, paper working, calico and/or paper bag making; (i) envelope making, stationery making and/or paper products working; (j) embossing; (k) cardboard box making, carton making (including the making of any kind of boxes and/or containers of paper and/or cardboard used alone or in combination with any other material or materials);

sources.title: Which system of employment laws applies
sources.publisher: Government of Western Australia (Private Sector Labour Relations)
sources.quote: The state system covers: Private sector businesses and their employees that operate as: Sole traders. Partnerships, where none of the partners in the business is a constitutional corporation (trading or financial corporation).

confidence_note: The award's list (cl 4.2) runs from printing and publishing to paper making and paper products; publishing staff such as journalists have their own award.

assessment.summary: The Graphic Arts, Printing and Publishing Award sets the industry's classifications, minimum pay, allowances and penalty rates on top of the National Employment Standards.

marks.reason: Classifications, allowances, penalty rates and their record-keeping add to the cost and complexity of employing in the industry.
